user.title: Connect to Brain Call
user.description: Brain Assist forwards the requests of Home Assistant's assistant to Brain Call. Where does Brain Call run?

menu_options.app: As an app on this system (found, started or installed)
menu_options.manual: On another computer, or enter address and token myself

manual.title: Connect to Brain Call
manual.description: Brain Assist forwards the requests of Home Assistant's assistant to Brain Call (version 1.11.0 or newer). The API token is in the file api-token.txt in the folder of the Brain Call app, or it is the one you set as API token there.

data_description.url: With Brain Call as an app on this system: http://127.0.0.1:8099
data_description.token: Without it Brain Call answers no request, not even from this system.

hassio_confirm.title: Brain Call found
hassio_confirm.description: The app {name} runs on this system and told Home Assistant its address and token. Connect Brain Assist to it?

add_repository_confirm.title: Install the Brain Call app
add_repository_confirm.description: Brain Call is not in the app store of this system yet. With your consent Brain Assist adds the repository {repository} to the app store, installs the Brain Call app, gives it the settings below and starts it. Without a phone account it only answers Assist. Phone, memory and everything else: app configuration.

data_description.anthropic_api_key: From console.anthropic.com. Brain Call does not start without it.
data_description.admin: This Home Assistant user may do everything in Assist. More people and devices: Callers in the app configuration.

install_app_confirm.title: Install the Brain Call app
install_app_confirm.description: With your consent Brain Assist installs the Brain Call app from {repository}, gives it the settings below and starts it. Without a phone account it only answers Assist. Phone, memory and everything else: app configuration.

data_description.anthropic_api_key: From console.anthropic.com. Brain Call does not start without it.
data_description.admin: This Home Assistant user may do everything in Assist. More people and devices: Callers in the app configuration.

app_settings.title: Settings for the Brain Call app
app_settings.description: The Brain Call app is installed but has no Claude API key, so it cannot start. Brain Assist puts the settings below into the app configuration and starts the app.

data_description.anthropic_api_key: From console.anthropic.com. Brain Call does not start without it.
data_description.admin: This Home Assistant user may do everything in Assist. More people and devices: Callers in the app configuration.

data_description.url: With Brain Call as an app on this system: http://127.0.0.1:8099
data_description.token: From api-token.txt in the folder of the Brain Call app, or the API token set there.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for Brain Call
reauth_confirm.description: Brain Call at {url} refused the stored token.

progress.install_app: Installing the Brain Call app. This can take a few minutes.
progress.start_app: Starting the Brain Call app and waiting for it to answer.

error.cannot_connect: Brain Call cannot be reached at this address. Is the app running, and is the address right?
error.too_old: This Brain Call is too old for Brain Assist. Update Brain Call to 1.11.0 or newer.
error.too_new: This Brain Call is newer than Brain Assist understands. Update Brain Assist.
error.unknown: The address did not answer like Brain Call. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Brain Call is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The Brain Call app cannot be reached. Its log says why.
abort.invalid_auth: Brain Call refused the token it announced. Restart the app.
abort.too_old: This Brain Call is too old for Brain Assist. Update the Brain Call app.
abort.too_new: This Brain Call is newer than Brain Assist understands. Update Brain Assist.
abort.unknown: The app did not answer like Brain Call. The log has the details.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The Brain Call app announced itself without address or token.
abort.app_info_failed: The app store of this system cannot be read. The log has the details.
abort.app_install_failed: Installing the Brain Call app failed. The log has the details. By hand: Settings → Apps → App store → ⋮ → Repositories: {repository}.
abort.app_start_failed: The Brain Call app did not start or did not answer in time. Its log (Settings → Apps → Brain Call → Log) says why.
abort.app_busy: The Brain Call app is being installed or updated right now. Try again when it is done.

brain_call_too_old.title: Brain Call is too old for Brain Assist
brain_call_too_old.description: Brain Call {version} speaks version {server_api} of its API, Brain Assist needs version {client_api}. Update the Brain Call app. Brain Assist connects again by itself afterwards.

brain_assist_too_old.title: Brain Assist is too old for Brain Call
brain_assist_too_old.description: Brain Call {version} speaks version {server_api} of its API, Brain Assist only understands version {client_api}. Update Brain Assist in the Marketplace and restart Home Assistant.

call.name: Plan a call
call.description: Brain Call calls a number or a person from Callers with a task, holds the conversation and reports the result (event braincall_task_finished, the to-do list, a notification and, if wanted, a call back). Needs planned calls on in Brain Call 1.14.0 or newer.

number.name: Number
number.description: Phone number to call. Leave it empty to call a person from Callers by name.

name.name: Name
name.description: Person or business to call; alone, the name of a person in Callers whose number is used.

task.name: Task
task.description: What the call is for, in your own words. Brain Call makes the plan from it.

not_before.name: Not before
not_before.description: Earliest time to call. Default: now.

not_after.name: Not after
not_after.description: Give up after this time. Default: 24 hours later.

retries.name: Retries
retries.description: Further attempts if nobody is reached. Default: 2.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the call. Default: as set in Brain Call.

call_back.name: Call back
call_back.description: Call the requester back with the result; needs a number in their Callers entry.

leave_message.name: Leave a message
leave_message.description: Leave a short message on a mailbox; that ends the task. Default: on.

config_entry_id.name: Brain Call
config_entry_id.description: Only with more than one Brain Call server; then it is needed.

not_loaded.message: Brain Assist is not connected to Brain Call.

tasks_off.message: Planned calls are off in Brain Call (Planned calls), or Brain Call is older than 1.14.0.

call_refused.message: Brain Call did not plan the call: {reason}

task_running.message: This call is running right now and cannot be cancelled.

task_finished.message: This call is over. Brain Call removes finished calls after 30 days.

cancel_refused.message: Brain Call did not cancel the call: {reason}

which_server.message: There is more than one Brain Call with planned calls: choose one (Brain Call).
